analysis.summary: Nidhi Granites Limited reported its financial results for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, showing a standalone loss of Rs. 148.56 Lakhs. The company's wholly owned subsidiary, SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited, divested its entire shareholding in Fine Papyrus Private Limited, which ceased to be a step-down subsidiary. Management highlighted that the company's performance has been steadily improving and expects accelerated growth in the coming year, particularly with the addition of the Fintech business. No dividend was recommended for the year, and the company provided a guarantee of ₹5 Crores to SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited divested its entire shareholding of 9,90,000 equity shares in Fine Papyrus Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, divested its entire shareholding comprising 9,90,000 equity shares in Fine Papyrus Private Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: Fine Papyrus Private Limited ceased to be a step-down subsidiary of the company on March 16, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Consequently, Fine Papyrus Private Limited ceased to be a step‐down subsidiary of the Company with effect from the 16th March 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has invested in various subsidiaries and is focusing on scaling up their operations.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has been deploying its resources productively; it has invested in various subsidiaries and is focusing on scaling up their operation.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired Auro Fintech Private Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary on April 1, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company acquired 12,500 Equity shares for a consideration of INR 60,57,000 of Auro Fintech Private Limited (CIN: U72900MH2022PTC377921) on 1st April 2025, making it a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.

margins_costs.claim: The company incurred a standalone loss of Rs. 148.56 Lakhs after providing for depreciation during the year under review.
margins_costs.quote: During the year under review the Company has incurred a loss of Rs. (148.56) Lakhs (Rupees one Hundred Forty Eights point Fifty‐Six Lakhs Only) (previous year profit of Rs. 122.90 Lakhs (Rupees one Hundred Twenty‐Two point Nine Zero lakhs Only) after providing depreciation.

capital_allocation.claim: The directors do not recommend any dividend for the current year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: Directors do not recommend any dividend for the current year under review.

capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not transferred any amount to General Reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The company provided a guarantee of ₹5 Crores to its wholly owned subsidiary, SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Company has not granted any loans or provided any guarantees or securities, except for a guarantee of ₹5 Crores provided to SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allotted 40,00,000 bonus equity shares in the proportion of one new fully paid-up equity share for every one existing equity share.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year the company allotted 40,00,000 bonus equity shares in the proportion of 1 (One) new fully paid‐up equity share of Rs. 10/‐ (Rupees Ten Only) each for every 1 (One) existing fully paid‐up equity share of Rs. 10/‐ (Rupees Ten Only) each to the shareholders of the Company on 4th May, 2024 and the same were listed on Bombay Stock Exchange (“BSE”) on 7th May, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The paid-up capital of the company increased from Rs. 4 crores to Rs. 8 crores following the bonus issue.
capital_allocation.quote: Considering the change in paid‐up capital as stated above, the paid‐up capital of the Company has been increased from Rs. 4 Cr/‐ (Rupees Four Crores Only) to Rs. 8 Cr/‐ (Rupees Eight Crores Only).
